disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may annul registration of a nurse found guilty of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board, after a hearing, by vote of a majority of its members, may annul the registration and cancel the certificate of any nurse who has been found guilty of a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may assess a penalty for each violation of regulations or general laws governing nursing practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may assess a licensed nurse a penalty of not more than $2,000 for each violation of regulations promulgated pursuant to this section and for each violation of any general law that governs the practice of nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to become registered or practicing under a false or assumed name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever becomes or attempts to become registered as a registered nurse or practices or attempts to practice professional nursing under a false or assumed name shall be punished by a fine of not less than five hundred nor more than one thousand dollars or imprisonment for one year, or both.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or attempting to practice professional nursing without lawful authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice as a registered nurse within the commonwealth, practices or attempts to practice professional nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of a rehabilitation program results in termination and reporting to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any failure to comply with the provisions of a rehabilitation program may result in termination of the participant from the rehabilitation program. The name and license number of a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse terminated for failure to comply with the provisions of a rehabilitation program shall be reported to the board.
